analysis.title: DuPont de Nemours Inc. (DD): First Take: 3Q beat, FY26 guide raised
key_insights: DD reported 3Q26 adj. segment EBITDA of $505mn, +5% vs both GS and Visible Alpha consensus of $479mn, driven largely by a beat in Diversified Industrials.
Organic sales growth was +5.0% vs GS +1.5%. Healthcare & Water Technologies grew +4.0% (GS +2.1%) and Diversified Industrials grew +5.0% (GS +1.1%).
DD raised its FY26 EBITDA guide to $1,785mn from $1,750mn-$1,770mn, vs GS/VA consensus of $1,760mn/$1,757mn. FY26 EPS guide rose to $7.47-$7.52 from $7.17-$7.32, vs GS/VA consensus of $7.25/$7.25.
The guidance raise largely reflects the $0.23 3Q EPS beat vs consensus. Management also raised its FY26 organic growth expectation to 4.5% from slightly above 4%.
DD introduced a 4Q26 EBITDA guide of $455mn (GS/VA consensus $449mn/$450mn) and a 4Q26 EPS guide of $1.90-$1.95 (GS/VA consensus $1.85/$1.87).
Diversified Industrials segment EBITDA was $242mn vs GS $224mn and VA $222mn, with margin of 24.1% vs GS 22.8%. Healthcare & Water Technologies EBITDA was $263mn vs GS $254mn, with margin of 30.4%.
Recurring diluted EPS was $2.09 vs GS $1.85 and VA $1.86. Total EBITDA incrementals were 45% vs GS 27%.
GS expects the shares to outperform on the day given the beat and raise. The rating is Neutral with a 12-month price target of $153 vs a $141.30 close on 2 Nov 2026.

market_movers.rationale: The 12-month target of $153 is based on 12.0x GS Q5-Q8E EBITDA. It implies 8.3% upside from $141.30. GS expects shares to outperform today after the 3Q beat and FY26 guide raise.

earnings_insights: DD 3Q26 adj. segment EBITDA reported $505mn vs GS/VA consensus estimates of $479mn/$479mn (reported 3 Nov 2026).
DD 3Q26 recurring diluted EPS reported $2.09 vs GS estimate $1.85 and VA consensus $1.86, a $0.23-$0.24 beat. 3Q25 actual was $1.29.
DD 3Q26 total revenue reported $1,868mn (+4.1% y/y) vs GS estimate $1,842mn and VA consensus $1,842mn.
DD 3Q26 organic growth reported +5.0% vs GS estimate +1.5%.
DD raised FY26 EBITDA guidance to $1,785mn from $1,750mn-$1,770mn (GS consensus $1,760mn, VA consensus $1,757mn) and FY26 EPS guidance to $7.47-$7.52 from $7.17-$7.32 (GS/VA consensus $7.25/$7.25).
DD introduced 4Q26 guidance: EBITDA of $455mn (GS/VA consensus $449mn/$450mn) and EPS of $1.90-$1.95 (GS/VA consensus $1.85/$1.87).
Corporate expense in 3Q26 was $36mn vs GS estimate $30mn and VA consensus $29.5mn, a 20%-22% overrun.
risk_factors: Upside: acceleration in general economic activity, continued portfolio transformation, pricing-driven margin expansion.
Downside: slowdown in general economic activity, PFAS and environmental liabilities, geopolitical risk.
